model: thermal-plate-surrogate: 5-member ensemble of field-to-field U-Nets with a conformal trust/solver gate

calibration_set.description: fresh plates, never used for training, early stopping or testing; OOD plates from the widened box (each range +25% of its width), the same sampler as the OOD test set

guarantee: For a query drawn like the calibration plates in its distance bin, the plate's interior RMSE is <= error_bound_90_C with probability >= 90%. Queries beyond max_calibrated_ood_distance are not certified and are always deferred.
notes: Edge temperatures are exact by construction (hard constraint).
Exactly scale-equivariant: scaling the source amplitude and all edges by c scales the field by c.
~3 ms per field per member on a laptop CPU; the 5-member ensemble ~15 ms.
